Synopsis:
Bex is hanging out by the bridge outside the Last Light alone. She's trying to get a few moments to herself to mourn, convinced that her boyfriend Danis is dead. The player can offer to help or alternatively blame her for how things unfolded (thus souring any future interactions).

Cluster Contexts:
- HAV_LoneLover_Bex.json: Bex is sitting alone by the bridge outside Last Light, grieving and convinced her boyfriend Danis was taken or killed when Absolute cultists rounded up survivors. Off‑screen she escaped while others — including wounded or able‑bodied captives — were driven toward Moonrise Towers, so Danis is likely missing, imprisoned, or worse. Moonrise personnel and nearby Absolute guards (zealots who mind‑meld to check for tadpoles and who delight in humiliating prisoners) control access and will shape any effort to find him. The player can either offer help (which gives Bex hope and improves rapport) or accuse/blame her for letting him go (which will sour future interactions).
- HAV_LoneLover_Danis.json: Danis' dialog in Haven after his rescue.He has made it safely to Haven after escaping Moonrise Towers and has been reunited with Bex, his partner, if she's alive, or is alone if she's not. If she's alive, the player witnessed a really cute reunion between them, and these dialogues cover Danis' followups to that conversation, as well as versions for if he's alone and for a few states in Haven. Not all states are covered since Danis doesn't care much about Ketheric
- HAV_HarperScouts_Harper_001.json: Dialogue with Meygan in Last Light. She is standing before an altar, mourning Yonas' death. She might give us something if we give her his sword. Despite changes in the state of the grove, she usually reverts to her normal dialogue/ state of sadness as she was close to Yonas and that's more to the front of her mind than stuff like Ketheric
- HAV_LoneLover_Reunited.json: Danis and Bex are reunited in the Last Light Inn after the player has saved Danis from being trapped in MOO. The two are ecstatic to see one another for the first time in a long time and very grateful to the player.
- HAV_AlfiraTale_Bard.json: Alfira has seen her friends, people she considered family, dragged screaming into the nigh. She is upset and only just holding it together. She asks the player to save the prisoners in Moonrise.

context: Bex is sitting alone by the bridge outside Last Light, mourning and convinced her boyfriend Danis was taken or killed when Absolute cultists rounded up survivors and dragged people off amid screams. Off‑screen she escaped while others — including wounded or able‑bodied captives — were driven toward Moonrise Towers, so Danis is likely missing, imprisoned, or worse; Moonrise personnel and nearby zealot guards (who mind‑meld to check for tadpoles and relish humiliating prisoners) control access and will make any rescue difficult. She’s fragile and alternately resentful and hopeful, blaming herself for letting him go and desperate for a chance to bring him back. The player can offer to search for Danis (giving her hope and improving rapport) or accuse/blame her for what happened (which will sour future interactions).
